facts.fact: 学院手册称 Grand Exam 自首届学员起就是五人一组、全体共同通过或失败，依据是 Mathé 有五个学徒并强调 healers 之间的信任
facts.anchor: a group of five scholars, who pass or fail in fellowship with one another

facts.fact: Konrad Omeyer 因近乎 burnout 休学一年后返校，本周面临可能不及格、再读一年五年级的压力
facts.anchor: on his return to the Academie from his year off after nearly burning out

facts.fact: Jehan 怀疑 Konrad 为了拿到复杂的 intervention-track 职位，可能把潜在竞争者清除掉——这是 Alys 讲的故事在他心里发作了
facts.anchor: Might he want it enough to clear his potential competition out of the way?

facts.fact: Jehan 赤手空拳猛击沙袋，打断了自己第五掌骨、又踢伤了膝盖，然后靠自己的魔法把伤治好
facts.anchor: The next punch snapped his fifth metacarpal

facts.fact: Ysabel Caudotte 的名字出现在一张写给 Jehan 本人的便条上，这张便条引出的问题远多于它能回答的
facts.anchor: a note which raised far more questions than it answered, addressed to Jehan himself

facts.fact: Jehan 十六岁那年意外 mage-tested，从而被送进 Academie
facts.anchor: When he’d mage-tested unexpectedly at sixteen

facts.fact: Jehan 眼下尽量不让 Guion Blavot 注意到自己，但明晚要去他那里，这也是他逃往 Fenehaf 之前的安排
facts.anchor: trying not to remind Guion Blavot of his existence any more than he had to

facts.fact: 章节收束时 Ysabel 已在火焰中，而 Jehan 还活着
facts.anchor: And Ysabel was in the flame, and Jehan was alive.
